messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Venlafaxine is not FDA approved for use in children.

The relation 'has new or worsening symptom' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with the new or worsening symptom specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'can worsen': The subject drug may increase the severity or negative impact of the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'causes': The subject drug leads to or results in the effect or condition specified by the object entity.
